summary: Ridgetech, Inc. (formerly China Jo-Jo Drugstores) furnished a Form 6-K on November 6, 2026 disclosing that its board approved appointing Chair Lingtao Kong as Chief Executive Officer effective November 1, 2026, succeeding Interim CEO Ming Zhao, who remains CFO. The filing includes Kong's two-year employment agreement through October 31, 2028, with annual cash compensation of HK$840,000 paid monthly, expense reimbursement, and D&O insurance coverage. This is a routine, orderly succession rather than an abrupt forced departure, so it does not qualify as a special situation; no transaction terms, advisor, or deal mechanics are implicated.
